      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Technology Stack\n\n## Build System \u0026 Package Management\n- **Runtime**: Bun (JavaScript/TypeScript), Python 3.9+\n- **Monorepo**: Turborepo with workspace configuration\n- **Package Manager**: Bun for JS/TS, pip/conda for Python\n\n## Frontend Stack\n- **Framework**: Next.js 15.3.5 with App Router\n- **React**: 19.1.0 with React Server Components\n- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4.1.11 + Radix UI components\n- **3D Graphics**: Three.js, React Three Fiber, React Three Drei\n- **Animations**: Framer Motion, GSAP\n- **State Management**: Zustand, React Context\n- **Real-time**: Liveblocks, PartySocket\n\n## Backend \u0026 Data\n- **Database**: Xata (PostgreSQL) with vector search capabilities\n- **Vector Storage**: Multi-backend (Upstash Vector, FAISS, pgvector)\n- **AI/ML**: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq via Vercel AI SDK\n- **Authentication**: Clerk\n- **File Storage**: Vercel Blob, Xata file attachments\n\n## Python RAG System\n- **Framework**: FastAPI, Streamlit\n- **AI/ML**: LangChain, sentence-transformers, torch\n- **Vector DBs**: FAISS, Upstash Vector, CocoIndex (pgvector)\n- **Document Processing**: PyPDF2, PyMuPDF, BeautifulSoup4\n- **CLI**: Charm CLI tools (gum, huh, glow, glamour)\n\n## Development Tools\n- **TypeScript**: 5.8+ with strict configuration\n- **Linting**: ESLint 9.30+ with Next.js config\n- **Component Development**: Storybook 8.6+\n- **Testing**: Jest, Storybook testing utilities\n- **Code Generation**: Plop for component scaffolding\n\n## Common Commands\n\n### Development\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Start main app\nbun run dev:app\n\n# Start Storybook\nbun run storybook\n\n# Python RAG system\ncd apps/disclosure-rag\npython streamlit_app.py    # Dashboard\npython api_server.py       # API server\npython cli.py             # Interactive CLI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Build \u0026 Deploy\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Build main app\nbun run build:app\n\n# Start production\nbun run start:app\n\n# Component audit\nbun run audit:components\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Data Operations\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Export Xata data\nbun run export:xata\n\n# Import data\nbun run import:data\nbun run import:events\n",

        "originalContents": "# Technology Stack\n\n## Build System \u0026 Package Management\n- **Runtime**: Bun (JavaScript/TypeScript), Python 3.9+\n- **Monorepo**: Turborepo with workspace configuration\n- **Package Manager**: Bun for JS/TS, pip/conda for Python\n\n## Frontend Stack\n- **Framework**: Next.js 15.3.5 with App Router\n- **React**: 19.1.0 with React Server Components\n- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4.1.11 + Radix UI components\n- **3D Graphics**: Three.js, React Three Fiber, React Three Drei\n- **Animations**: Framer Motion, GSAP\n- **State Management**: Zustand, React Context\n- **Real-time**: Liveblocks, PartySocket\n\n## Backend \u0026 Data\n- **Database**: Xata (PostgreSQL) with vector search capabilities\n- **Vector Storage**: Multi-backend (Upstash Vector, FAISS, pgvector)\n- **AI/ML**: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq via Vercel AI SDK\n- **Authentication**: Clerk\n- **File Storage**: Vercel Blob, Xata file attachments\n\n## Python RAG System\n- **Framework**: FastAPI, Streamlit\n- **AI/ML**: LangChain, sentence-transformers, torch\n- **Vector DBs**: FAISS, Upstash Vector, CocoIndex (pgvector)\n- **Document Processing**: PyPDF2, PyMuPDF, BeautifulSoup4\n- **CLI**: Charm CLI tools (gum, huh, glow, glamour)\n\n## Development Tools\n- **TypeScript**: 5.8+ with strict configuration\n- **Linting**: ESLint 9.30+ with Next.js config\n- **Component Development**: Storybook 8.6+\n- **Testing**: Jest, Storybook testing utilities\n- **Code Generation**: Plop for component scaffolding\n\n## Common Commands\n\n### Development\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Start main app\nbun run dev:app\n\n# Start Storybook\nbun run storybook\n\n# Python RAG system\ncd apps/disclosure-rag\npython streamlit_app.py    # Dashboard\npython api_server.py       # API server\npython cli.py             # Interactive CLI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Build \u0026 Deploy\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Build main app\nbun run build:app\n\n# Start production\nbun run start:app\n\n# Component audit\nbun run audit:components\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Data Operations\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Export Xata data\nbun run export:xata\n\n# Import data\nbun run import:data\nbun run import:events\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Storybook Documentation Standards\n\n## Story Structure and Organization\n\n### Story File Naming\n\n- **Co-locate stories** with component files\n- **Use component name** + &#96;.stories.tsx&#96; extension\n- **Group related stories** in the same file\n- **Export stories** as named exports\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ✅ DO: Proper story file structure\n// PersonnelFileCard.stories.tsx\nimport type {Meta, StoryObj} from '@storybook/react'\nimport {PersonnelFileCard} from './PersonnelFileCard'\n\nconst meta: Meta\u003ctypeof PersonnelFileCard\u003e = {\n  title: 'Documents/PersonnelFileCard',\n  component: PersonnelFileCard,\n  parameters: {\n    layout: 'centered',\n  },\n  tags: ['autodocs'],\n}\n\nexport default meta\ntype Story = StoryObj\u003ctypeof PersonnelFileCard\u003e\n\nexport const Default: Story = {\n  args: {\n    personnel: {\n      id: '1',\n      name: 'John Smith',\n      classification: 'secret',\n      date: '1963-05-15',\n      rank: 'Captain',\n      serviceNumber: '12345',\n      organization: 'NASA',\n    },\n  },\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Story Organization\n\n- **Group by feature** in Storybook sidebar\n- **Use consistent naming** for story variants\n- **Include comprehensive examples** for all props\n- **Document edge cases** and error states\n\n## Component Documentation\n\n### Meta Configuration\n\n- **Set appropriate title** for component grouping\n- **Configure layout** (centered, fullscreen, etc.)\n- **Enable autodocs** for automatic documentation\n- **Add tags** for categorization and search\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ✅ DO: Comprehensive meta configuration\n",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# Storybook Documentation Standards"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "## Story Structure and Organization"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "### Story File Naming"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "- **Co-locate stories** with component files"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "- **Use component name** + &#96;.stories.tsx&#96; extension"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "- **Group related stories** in the same file"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "- **Export stories** as named exports"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "// ✅ DO: Proper story file structure"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "// PersonnelFileCard.stories.tsx"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "import type {Meta, StoryObj} from '@storybook/react'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "import {PersonnelFileCard} from './PersonnelFileCard'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "const meta: Meta\u003ctypeof PersonnelFileCard\u003e = {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "  title: 'Documents/PersonnelFileCard',"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "  component: PersonnelFileCard,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "  parameters: {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "    layout: 'centered',"

        "originalContents": "# Storybook Documentation Standards\n\n## Story Structure and Organization\n\n### Story File Naming\n\n- **Co-locate stories** with component files\n- **Use component name** + &#96;.stories.tsx&#96; extension\n- **Group related stories** in the same file\n- **Export stories** as named exports\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ✅ DO: Proper story file structure\n// PersonnelFileCard.stories.tsx\nimport type {Meta, StoryObj} from '@storybook/react'\nimport {PersonnelFileCard} from './PersonnelFileCard'\n\nconst meta: Meta\u003ctypeof PersonnelFileCard\u003e = {\n  title: 'Documents/PersonnelFileCard',\n  component: PersonnelFileCard,\n  parameters: {\n    layout: 'centered',\n  },\n  tags: ['autodocs'],\n}\n\nexport default meta\ntype Story = StoryObj\u003ctypeof PersonnelFileCard\u003e\n\nexport const Default: Story = {\n  args: {\n    personnel: {\n      id: '1',\n      name: 'John Smith',\n      classification: 'secret',\n      date: '1963-05-15',\n      rank: 'Captain',\n      serviceNumber: '12345',\n      organization: 'NASA',\n    },\n  },\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Story Organization\n\n- **Group by feature** in Storybook sidebar\n- **Use consistent naming** for story variants\n- **Include comprehensive examples** for all props\n- **Document edge cases** and error states\n\n## Component Documentation\n\n### Meta Configuration\n\n- **Set appropriate title** for component grouping\n- **Configure layout** (centered, fullscreen, etc.)\n- **Enable autodocs** for automatic documentation\n- **Add tags** for categorization and search\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ✅ DO: Comprehensive meta configuration\n",

        "contents": "2. **User Theories**\n   - Properties: name, content, synopsis, diagrams\n   - Relationships: saved entities (events, topics, personnel, etc.)\n\n3. **User-Saved Entities**\n   - Various tables tracking user-saved content (events, topics, personnel, etc.)\n   - Each includes notes and connections to theories\n\n### 4.2 Storage and Retrieval Patterns\n\nThe application employs several data access patterns:\n\n#### 4.2.1 Direct Retrieval\n\n- Single entity lookup by ID or unique property\n- Relationship traversal for connected entities\n- Filtered list retrieval with sorting and pagination\n\n#### 4.2.2 Search Capabilities\n\n- Full-text search across entity properties\n- Vector search for semantic similarity\n- Fuzzy matching for approximate results\n- Faceted search with filtering options\n\n#### 4.2.3 Aggregation and Analysis\n\n- Entity count and distribution analysis\n- Relationship density and connectivity metrics\n- Temporal analysis for event patterns\n- Geographical clustering and distribution\n\n## 5. Development Workflow\n\n### 5.1 Environment Setup\n\nThe UltraTerrestrial project utilizes a consistent development environment:\n\n#### 5.1.1 Local Development\n\n- Node.js/Bun for JavaScript runtime\n- Python environment for disclosure-rag\n- Environment variables (.env files) for configuration\n- Local database setup with Xata CLI\n\n#### 5.1.2 Development Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Start the main app in development mode\nbun run dev:app\n\n# Run Storybook for component development\nbun run storybook\n\n# Build the main application\nbun run build:app\n\n# Run CLI commands\ncd apps/cli \u0026\u0026 bun run dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5.2 Build and Deployment\n\nThe project uses a structured build and deployment process:\n\n#### 5.2.1 Build Pipeline\n\n1. Dependency installation\n2. Type checking with TypeScript\n3. Linting with ESLint\n4. Building with Next.js/Turborepo\n5. Testing with Jest (when applicable)\n\n#### 5.2.2 Deployment\n\n- Vercel deployment for web applications\n- Docker containerization for server components (where applicable)\n",

        "originalContents": "import { Meta, Story, Canvas } from '@storybook/blocks'\nimport * as EvidenceStories from './evidence.stories'\n\n\u003cMeta title=\"Features/Case Files/Evidence/Documentation\" /\u003e\n\n# Evidence System Components\n\nThe evidence system consists of several interconnected components that work together to provide a comprehensive interface for managing and viewing case evidence.\n\n## Overview\n\nThe evidence system includes:\n- Evidence Cards for displaying individual pieces of evidence\n- Evidence Browser for navigating the evidence database\n- Evidence Detail Sidebar for in-depth evidence examination\n\n## Components\n\n### Evidence Card\n\nThe Evidence Card component displays key information about a piece of evidence including:\n- Classification level (top-secret, classified, confidential)\n- Credibility score\n- Source verification status\n- Timestamp\n- Description\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n\u003cEvidenceCard\n  caseNumber=\"X-37B\"\n  classification=\"top-secret\"\n  timestamp=\"2077-03-15T21:27:18\"\n  title=\"Quantum Encryption Breach\"\n  description=\"Unauthorized access detected in quantum mainframe sector 7.\"\n  credibilityScore={0.87}\n  sourceVerified={true}\n/\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Evidence Browser\n\nThe Evidence Browser provides a hierarchical view of evidence files organized into folders. Features include:\n- Searchable interface\n- Classified folder indicators\n- File metadata display\n- Interactive folder navigation\n\n### Evidence Detail Sidebar\n\nThe Detail Sidebar shows comprehensive information about selected evidence:\n- Full metadata\n- Analysis graphs\n- Status indicators\n- Processing state\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n### Basic Evidence Card\n\n\u003cCanvas of={EvidenceStories.SingleEvidenceCard} /\u003e\n\n### Multiple Classification Levels\n\n\u003cCanvas of={EvidenceStories.EvidenceCardVariants} /\u003e\n\n### Complete Interface\n\n\u003cCanvas of={EvidenceStories.FullInterface} /\u003e\n\n## Implementation Notes\n\n### Animations and Transitions\n- Uses Framer Motion for smooth animations\n- Implements staggered animations for folder contents\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Project Structure\n\n## Monorepo Organization\nUltraTerrestrial follows a monorepo pattern with Turborepo, organized into applications and shared packages.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nultraterrestrial-resurrection/\n├── apps/                    # Applications (3 main apps)\n├── packages/               # Shared packages (5 packages)\n├── docs/                   # Project documentation\n├── scripts/                # Build and utility scripts\n└── *.md                   # Root documentation files\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Applications (&#96;/apps/&#96;)\n\n### Main App (&#96;/apps/app/&#96;)\nPrimary Next.js application with the research platform interface.\n\n**Key Structure:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nsrc/\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router\n│   ├── (auth)/            # Authentication routes\n│   ├── (site)/            # Public site routes\n│   └── api/               # API endpoints\n├── components/            # UI components (50+ categories)\n├── features/              # Feature modules\n│   ├── mindmap/           # Enhanced nodes, spatial grouping, tours\n│   ├── 3d/                # Three.js visualizations\n│   ├── ai/                # AI integration and chat\n│   └── data-viz/          # Data visualization components\n├── hooks/                 # Custom React hooks\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n└── utils/                 # Helper functions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Disclosure RAG (&#96;/apps/disclosure-rag/&#96;)\nPython-based RAG system with triple backend architecture.\n\n**Key Structure:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nlib/\n├── adapters/              # RAG system adapters\n├── storage/               # Vector storage backends\n├── entity_extraction/     # NER and entity processing\n└── visualization/         # Data visualization tools\nagents/                    # AI agent implementations\nscripts/                   # Batch processing scripts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Research Canvas (&#96;/apps/research-canvas/&#96;)\n",

          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "### Research Canvas (&#96;/apps/research-canvas/&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "TipTap-based research editor with AI integration."
          }
        ],
        "originalContents": "# Project Structure\n\n## Monorepo Organization\nUltraTerrestrial follows a monorepo pattern with Turborepo, organized into applications and shared packages.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nultraterrestrial-resurrection/\n├── apps/                    # Applications (3 main apps)\n├── packages/               # Shared packages (5 packages)\n├── docs/                   # Project documentation\n├── scripts/                # Build and utility scripts\n└── *.md                   # Root documentation files\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Applications (&#96;/apps/&#96;)\n\n### Main App (&#96;/apps/app/&#96;)\nPrimary Next.js application with the research platform interface.\n\n**Key Structure:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nsrc/\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router\n│   ├── (auth)/            # Authentication routes\n│   ├── (site)/            # Public site routes\n│   └── api/               # API endpoints\n├── components/            # UI components (50+ categories)\n├── features/              # Feature modules\n│   ├── mindmap/           # Enhanced nodes, spatial grouping, tours\n│   ├── 3d/                # Three.js visualizations\n│   ├── ai/                # AI integration and chat\n│   └── data-viz/          # Data visualization components\n├── hooks/                 # Custom React hooks\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n└── utils/                 # Helper functions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Disclosure RAG (&#96;/apps/disclosure-rag/&#96;)\nPython-based RAG system with triple backend architecture.\n\n**Key Structure:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nlib/\n├── adapters/              # RAG system adapters\n├── storage/               # Vector storage backends\n├── entity_extraction/     # NER and entity processing\n└── visualization/         # Data visualization tools\nagents/                    # AI agent implementations\nscripts/                   # Batch processing scripts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Research Canvas (&#96;/apps/research-canvas/&#96;)\n",
        "range": {

            "line": 54
          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n**Case Files:**\n- CIA Documents (RDP series)\n- UFO/UAP Reports  \n- Project Blue Book files\n- Congressional Hearings\n- Witness Testimony\n- Roswell Incident files\n\n**Transcripts:**\n- Joe Rogan Podcast episodes\n- Military/Navy testimonies\n- Disclosure-related interviews\n- David Grusch testimonies\n- Luis Elizondo interviews\n\n## Development\n\n### Environment Variables\n\nCreate &#96;.env.local&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nNEXT_PUBLIC_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\nnpm install\n\n# Start development server\nnpm run dev\n\n# Build for production\nnpm run build\n\n# Start production server\nnpm start\n\n# Run linting\nnpm run lint\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napps/research-canvas/\n├── components/\n│   ├── ui/                    # Reusable UI components\n│   ├── integrated-dashboard.tsx   # Main dashboard\n│   ├── knowledge-base-browser.tsx # Knowledge base interface\n│   └── ...\n├── hooks/\n│   └── use-knowledge-base.ts  # Data fetching hooks\n├── lib/\n│   ├── knowledge-base-api.ts  # API client functions\n│   └── utils.ts              # Utility functions\n├── app/                      # Next.js app directory\n├── utils/                    # Data utilities\n└── ...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API Integration\n\n### Available Endpoints\n\n- &#96;GET /stats&#96; - Knowledge base statistics\n- &#96;GET /documents&#96; - List documents with filtering\n- &#96;GET /documents/{id}&#96; - Get specific document\n- &#96;GET /search&#96; - Search documents\n- &#96;GET /tags&#96; - Available tags\n- &#96;GET /categories&#96; - Document categories\n\n### Example Usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { getDocuments, searchDocuments } from './lib/knowledge-base-api';\n\n// Get CIA documents\nconst ciaFiles = await getDocuments({ \n  tags: 'cia', \n  docType: 'case_file' \n});\n\n// Search for UFO sightings\nconst results = await searchDocuments({ \n  query: 'UFO sighting', \n  limit: 20 \n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Customization\n\n### Adding New Components\n",

        "originalContents": "\n**Case Files:**\n- CIA Documents (RDP series)\n- UFO/UAP Reports  \n- Project Blue Book files\n- Congressional Hearings\n- Witness Testimony\n- Roswell Incident files\n\n**Transcripts:**\n- Joe Rogan Podcast episodes\n- Military/Navy testimonies\n- Disclosure-related interviews\n- David Grusch testimonies\n- Luis Elizondo interviews\n\n## Development\n\n### Environment Variables\n\nCreate &#96;.env.local&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nNEXT_PUBLIC_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\nnpm install\n\n# Start development server\nnpm run dev\n\n# Build for production\nnpm run build\n\n# Start production server\nnpm start\n\n# Run linting\nnpm run lint\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napps/research-canvas/\n├── components/\n│   ├── ui/                    # Reusable UI components\n│   ├── integrated-dashboard.tsx   # Main dashboard\n│   ├── knowledge-base-browser.tsx # Knowledge base interface\n│   └── ...\n├── hooks/\n│   └── use-knowledge-base.ts  # Data fetching hooks\n├── lib/\n│   ├── knowledge-base-api.ts  # API client functions\n│   └── utils.ts              # Utility functions\n├── app/                      # Next.js app directory\n├── utils/                    # Data utilities\n└── ...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API Integration\n\n### Available Endpoints\n\n- &#96;GET /stats&#96; - Knowledge base statistics\n- &#96;GET /documents&#96; - List documents with filtering\n- &#96;GET /documents/{id}&#96; - Get specific document\n- &#96;GET /search&#96; - Search documents\n- &#96;GET /tags&#96; - Available tags\n- &#96;GET /categories&#96; - Document categories\n\n### Example Usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { getDocuments, searchDocuments } from './lib/knowledge-base-api';\n\n// Get CIA documents\nconst ciaFiles = await getDocuments({ \n  tags: 'cia', \n  docType: 'case_file' \n});\n\n// Search for UFO sightings\nconst results = await searchDocuments({ \n  query: 'UFO sighting', \n  limit: 20 \n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Customization\n\n### Adding New Components\n",

        "contents": "import { Meta, Story, Canvas } from '@storybook/blocks'\nimport * as EvidenceStories from './evidence.stories'\n\n\u003cMeta title=\"Features/Case Files/Evidence/Documentation\" /\u003e\n\n# Evidence System Components\n\nThe evidence system consists of several interconnected components that work together to provide a comprehensive interface for managing and viewing case evidence.\n\n## Overview\n\nThe evidence system includes:\n- Evidence Cards for displaying individual pieces of evidence\n- Evidence Browser for navigating the evidence database\n- Evidence Detail Sidebar for in-depth evidence examination\n\n## Components\n\n### Evidence Card\n\nThe Evidence Card component displays key information about a piece of evidence including:\n- Classification level (top-secret, classified, confidential)\n- Credibility score\n- Source verification status\n- Timestamp\n- Description\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n\u003cEvidenceCard\n  caseNumber=\"X-37B\"\n  classification=\"top-secret\"\n  timestamp=\"2077-03-15T21:27:18\"\n  title=\"Quantum Encryption Breach\"\n  description=\"Unauthorized access detected in quantum mainframe sector 7.\"\n  credibilityScore={0.87}\n  sourceVerified={true}\n/\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Evidence Browser\n\nThe Evidence Browser provides a hierarchical view of evidence files organized into folders. Features include:\n- Searchable interface\n- Classified folder indicators\n- File metadata display\n- Interactive folder navigation\n\n### Evidence Detail Sidebar\n\nThe Detail Sidebar shows comprehensive information about selected evidence:\n- Full metadata\n- Analysis graphs\n- Status indicators\n- Processing state\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n### Basic Evidence Card\n\n\u003cCanvas of={EvidenceStories.SingleEvidenceCard} /\u003e\n\n### Multiple Classification Levels\n\n\u003cCanvas of={EvidenceStories.EvidenceCardVariants} /\u003e\n\n### Complete Interface\n\n\u003cCanvas of={EvidenceStories.FullInterface} /\u003e\n\n## Implementation Notes\n\n### Animations and Transitions\n- Uses Framer Motion for smooth animations\n- Implements staggered animations for folder contents\n",
        "detailedLines": [

I need to clarify for the user that "CSF3" stands for Component Story Format version 3 in Storybook. This style includes default export meta and named story objects without requiring the .bind Template. It emphasizes type-safe Stories and utilizes autodocs. Key points include that stories are plain objects and export default meta defines the title and component, with each story being an object with args. The Todo2 workflow is mandatory for all requests, so I need to create Todo(s) for this question.

_**Agent (default)**_

CSF3 is Storybook’s Component Story Format v3: a concise, object-based way to define stories. You export a default meta (component, title, tags) and individual stories as plain objects (no Template functions). Stories use args to configure the component, and Autodocs can generate docs from the meta.

- • Key points:
  - • Default export meta: title, component, optional tags/parameters
  - • Stories are plain objects with args
  - • Works with Autodocs in Storybook 8+
  - • Type-safe via Meta/StoryObj in TypeScript

Minimal example:
```ts
import type {Meta, StoryObj} from '@storybook/react'
import Button from './Button'

const meta = {
  title: 'UI/Button',
  component: Button,
  tags: ['autodocs'],
} satisfies Meta<typeof Button>

export default meta
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>

export const Primary: Story = {
  args: {variant: 'primary', children: 'Click me'},
}
```

### Quick fixes

- • Missing providers (MindMap + React Flow): Wrap mindmap UI stories with these providers, in this order.
- • Container size: React Flow needs a sized container; add a wrapper with height.
- • Invalid style prop: Replace string styles with objects; remove any copy‑pasted HTML with `style="..."`.
- • Next/router usage: If a story uses Next router, mock it in a decorator.

Minimal decorator for mindmap stories:
```ts
// .storybook/preview.tsx or per-story file
import {ReactFlowProvider} from '@xyflow/react'
import {MindMapProvider} from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'
// Optional: if your context depends on this
import {StateOfDisclosureProvider} from '@/contexts/state-of-disclosure-provider'

export const decorators = [
  (Story) => (
    <div style={{height: '80vh', minHeight: 600}}>
      <ReactFlowProvider>
        <StateOfDisclosureProvider>
          <MindMapProvider>
            <Story />
          </MindMapProvider>
        </StateOfDisclosureProvider>
      </ReactFlowProvider>
    </div>
  ),
]
```

Fix style prop errors:
```tsx
// Wrong (string)
<div style="margin-right: 1em" />

// Correct (object)
<div style={{ marginRight: '1em' }} />
```

If a component depends on Next.js router:
```ts
// e.g., in a story file
jest.mock('next/navigation', () => ({
  usePathname: () => '/',
}))
```

Common root causes:
- • Using a mindmap component without `ReactFlowProvider` → runtime errors from hooks
- • `MindMapProvider` created before its import resolves (circular import) → wrap in decorator as above
- • No sized container → React Flow throws/doesn’t render
- • Copy‑pasted HTML with `style="..."` → “style expects a mapping” error

Try the decorator + container first; that resolves most “Cannot access 'MindMapContext'” and render issues.
